acceptedVulnerabilities.reason: an unmaintained-crate notice, not a vulnerability: heapless 0.7 (via postcard, via phonenumber) names atomic-polyfill only for targets without native atomics; the controller is built for Linux and macOS, where the crate is not compiled (cargo tree -i atomic-polyfill is empty for the host)
acceptedVulnerabilities.reviewWhen: phonenumber's postcard moves to heapless 0.8 or later, which dropped atomic-polyfill
